# B2B SaaS Starter repository context

The Starter is the repository product. The public Showcase Site explains it; the Reference Application demonstrates workspace behavior. Use Member and Workspace Role for workspace access. System Admin is a separate global role with no workspace bypass.

## System boundaries

Three Cloudflare Workers share Effect capabilities. The TanStack Start web Worker calls them in-process through loaders and server functions. The API Worker exposes REST and MCP through a shared operation catalog. The background Worker handles queued webhook delivery, workspace exports, billing synchronization, and notification email.

D1 holds application and authentication state. Better Auth owns session and plugin-backed identity mutations. Request boundaries enforce permissions before invoking business capabilities. Seed and Live adapters share contracts and the deterministic Starter Lab identity.

Optional Stripe, email, social sign-in, Turnstile, observability, and AI providers activate from configuration. Local development works before they are configured. A configured provider failure must not silently grant access or substitute demo data.

## Integration and operation

REST uses workspace API Tokens. MCP also accepts OAuth consent bound to one Workspace; mutations recheck current consent. Token plaintext is shown on issuance, while verification uses stored hashes, expiry, revocation, and entitlements.

Billing synchronization verifies current provider state. Access uses a time-dependent Effective Plan, preserving stored resources when paid access ends. Webhook retries and manual replays preserve delivery evidence. Workspace exports are gzipped JSON archives, not database backups.

Customer deployments need monitoring and an isolated recovery drill. Shared-D1 recovery requires closing the whole application, restoring independent security evidence, and reconciling queues and external providers before reopening.
